Final for Publication

SUBSTITUTE # 2304171

NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR THE PROPOSED ZONING AMENDMENT TYPE 1.

6332-40 N. Pulaski RD.

The subject property contains a 2-story commercial building and a parking lot. The
applicant seeks to rezone the subject property from a B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping
District to an RS3 Residential Single-Unit(Detached) House District. The application is
for a Type 1 Map Amendment in order to allow the construction of five 2-story witha
basement detached single-family residences, with 2-rear parking spaces. The subject
property Is in a TSL Transit-Served Location with 1,320 feet of a CTA bus line corridor
(Devon Bus#53).

PROJECT BULK AND DENSITY
Use: 5-Residential Single-dwelling detached homes.
LOTAREA: 23' x 124,.13’=2,855 square feet.

FLOOR AREA RATIO: 0.9 2,566 square feet.
BUILDING FLOORAREA: 2,569 square feet

MIN. LOT AREA/DWELLING UNIT: 2,850 square feet.
OFF-STREET PARKING SPACES: _ 2

FRONT SETBACK: 117-6"

REAR SETBACK: 37.2 feet to rear of homes, 2 feet to the private garages.
REARYARD OPEN SPACE: 225 square feet

SIDE SETBACK: 3feet North 2 feet South

BUILDING HEIGHT: 30 Feet

Pursuant to Section:17-13-0303-D. Optional Administrative Adjustments and Variations.

ADMINISTRATIVE ADJUSTMENTS and VARIATIONS: 17-13-1000, 17-13-1003-1,17-13-1100,17-13-
1101-A,17-13-1101-8 and are seeking all zoning relief as needed and as atlowed by the Chicago
Zoning Code. The project is in a Transit Served Location (TOD) located within 1,320 feet of the
CTA bus line corridor roadway segment (Devon Bus#53).
